description: This file defines the Drawing class which is responsible for writing image and chart drawings to XLSX XML format in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods for serializing drawing objects, charts, and header/footer images, as well as retrieving all drawings from a spreadsheet.

classes.name: Drawing
classes.description: Handles serialization of image and chart drawings to XLSX format within PhpSpreadsheet.

methods.name: writeDrawings
methods.description: Serializes all drawings (images and optionally charts) in a worksheet into XML format.

methods.name: writeChart
methods.description: Serializes a single chart object to XML format.

methods.name: writeDrawing
methods.description: Serializes an individual drawing (image) object to XML format.

methods.name: writeVMLHeaderFooterImages
methods.description: Serializes header and footer images in VML format for headers/footers.

methods.name: allDrawings
methods.description: Retrieves all drawing objects from the entire spreadsheet.
